title: The First Note on the Recorder
youtube_title: The First Note on the Recorder | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Trying the smallest brave step still counts.
summary: At a bakery counter facing the street, Tamsin feels shy about a first note on a recorder. Instead of pretending not to care, Tamsin tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while the ferryman stays kind and does not push for a show.
